image_description: A side-rear view of an orange minibus (likely a converted van chassis) parked on asphalt. The vehicle features a high roof, multiple side windows, and a rear cargo/passenger door. It has black trim, a rear bumper with steps, and visible license plate. Another red vehicle is partially visible in the background left.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits a distinct boxy silhouette typical of a minibus/high-roof van. Its proportions are consistent with a vehicle shorter than a full-size bus but taller than a standard car.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is visible, and there is a clear row of rectangular side windows running along the passenger compartment.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has a high roofline. A sliding door track and handle mechanism are visible on the side, indicating a mid-body entrance.
The panel gap and handle configuration on the side correspond to a sliding door mechanism common in minibuses.
The front section of the vehicle extends forward of the windshield, housing the engine compartment typical of this van-based minibus design.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is vertical/flat, featuring mounted taillights and a clearly visible license plate.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle is painted bright orange with white stripes and text/logos, fitting the description of company livery/route markings.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The wheels are proportional to the vehicle size, appearing as standard steel rims with hubcaps, consistent with a heavy-duty van/minibus.
The window count and overall length suggest a capacity within the 4-10 passenger range, distinguishing it from larger city buses.

artifact_observations.location: Side panel text and rear license plate
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the side ('...BUS') and the license plate characters are distorted and illegible. While some blur is expected, the character structures are malformed, typical of AI generation struggling with small text.
The rear bumper geometry is inconsistent. The step appears to merge into the tire well without a clear mechanical connection, and the horizontal lines of the bumper warp slightly near the wheel arch.
The horizontal lines of the windows and the roof edge show slight waviness rather than being perfectly straight, indicating minor perspective warping common in generated vehicles.
